run_parallel_compose_benchmark: run the parallel compose benchmark to time gtn.compose forward and backward passes on batches of linear graphs
run_parallel_forward_score_benchmark: run the parallel forward_score benchmark to time gtn.forward_score forward and backward passes on batches of graphs
run_parallel_indexed_func_benchmark: run the parallel indexed function benchmark to time gtn.parallel_for with a custom Python processing function
review_time_compose: review the time_compose function that benchmarks parallel composition of two batches of GTN linear graphs with backward pass
review_time_forward_score: review the time_forward_score function that benchmarks parallel forward scoring on a batch of GTN linear graphs
